title: Memory Reactivation Levels Remain Unaffected by Anticipated Interference
description: EEG dataset from a visual working memory interference task (Experiment 1) investigating whether memory reactivation levels are affected by anticipated interference. Participants memorized a cued target object among two lateral objects; interference objects were shown in half of the blocks, followed by a probe and feedback. Preprocessing steps are described in an accompanying preprint and OSF repository referenced by the dataset authors.
methods_description: Each trial began with a space key press and a fixation dot (1000-1500 ms). A cued target (learned) and an irrelevant novel object appeared laterally, and participants memorized the cued object. After a 1400 ms delay, interference objects were briefly presented in half of the blocks (otherwise fixation only). A probe with two vertically aligned objects followed, and participants selected the target with arrow keys, then received color-coded feedback for 1000 ms.
